column1: # Layton's Mystery Journey: Katrielle and the Millionaires' Conspiracy DX+ on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# LEVEL-5's engine on SDK 5.4.0, OpenGL through EGL: main imports the GL entry points and subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_OpenGL) is not loaded (the Android GL layer answers its EGL imports),
# subsdk1 (NintendoSDK_movie) plays the AVC movies. Update 1.1.0 (v65536) + DLC 0100FDB00AA8100A.
# Tested 2026-11-16 on the iQOO 9 (Snapdragon 8 Gen 1, Adreno 730, Android 15), 2400x1080, OpenGL ES 3.2: the port completes, the title logo and the menus draw,
# dialogue text renders (the GL_ALPHA glyph atlas is converted to RGBA8), the opening AVC movie plays with its colour, the 3D scenes and the daily-puzzle list were played.
# 30 fps, the engine's own fixed step; 0 audio underruns in the 2,000 callbacks the log counts.

column2: update 1.1.0 · 30 fps (as on Switch) · OpenGL ES · tested on the iQOO 9 (Adreno 730)
